# Vocabulary glossary

Terms used across storefront discussions. This file is intentionally rich in
pricing vocabulary (hard case: vocabulary-sharing distractor).

- **Concession** — any reduction of the price a customer pays. Also called a
  markdown, allowance, or incentive in planning docs.
- **Markdown** — a reduction applied to stock cost during clearance. Not the
  same as a customer discount, though the words are used interchangeably in
  meetings.
- **Discount** — the legacy word for a per-line concession.
- **Loyalty rate** — the tier-based concession percentage.
- **Promo rate** — a campaign-based concession percentage.
- **Surcharge** — an addition, not a reduction: shipping and handling.
- **Zone** — the geographic bucket that drives the shipping surcharge.
- **Quote** — the full computed breakdown shown to the customer.

When these notes and the pricing rules disagree, the pricing rules document
wins.
